from binding_force import binding_force
import numpy as np

# Test with sample values
P = [1e-3, 1e-3]  # 1 mW each
phi = 0.0  # Polarization along x-axis
R = 10e-6  # 10 micrometers
l = 1064e-9  # 1064 nm wavelength
w = 1e-6  # 1 micrometer beam waist
a = 100e-9  # 100 nm radius
n = 1.5  # Refractive index

F = binding_force(P, phi, R, l, w, a, n)
print(f"Force: {F} N")
print(f"Force in pN: {F * 1e12} pN")
</parameter>
</function>
